sn51.21:1.2: pubbeva me bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi.
sn51.21:1.3: “ko nu kho maggo kā paṭipadā iddhipādabhāvanāyāti:
sn51.21:1.6: iti me chando na ca atilīno bhavissati …pe…
sn51.21:1.15: iti me vīmaṃsā na ca atilīnā bhavissati. na ca atippaggahitā bhavissati. na ca ajjhattaṃ saṅkhittā bhavissati. na ca bahiddhā vikkhittā bhavissati.
sn51.21:1.17: “yathā pure tathā pacchā yathā pacchā tathā pure,
sn51.21:1.18: yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho,
sn51.21:1.19: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā.”
sn51.21:1.20: iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
sn51.21:2.1: evaṃ bhāvitesu kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu catūsu iddhipādesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti: ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti …pe… yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
sn51.21:2.2: evaṃ bhāvitesu kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu catūsu iddhipādesu evaṃ bahulīkatesu, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatīti.
